name: Chop Chop Fruit Salad Mystery Jam Dokidoki Dating Sim Thingy
source:
In this super sugoi and awesome dating sim, you play as Apple, a completely normal fruit and student.
A dangerous murderer called The Chopper has been chopping up fruits lately in Apple's town.
Will Apple figure out the mystery? And, more importantly, who will Apple end up romancing and also fucking?
Much squirting fruit juice!
